name: Hopf rule
summary: A Z- and X-spider connected by two wires disconnect.
description:
When a Z-spider and an X-spider are connected by two wires, both wires can be removed. This expresses that the Z- and X-bases are *complementary* (mutually unbiased). More generally, spiders of opposite colour connected by k wires can have their connection reduced to k mod 2 wires.

The Hopf rule follows from the bialgebra rule together with the other phase-free rules.
